rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Ben, Dev, Fay, Ada, Cal, Eli. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 4 and 8 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Ben.say: Proposal: everyone claims only the 1 token needed to stay in the game each round. Over-claiming gets cut proportionally anyway, and total supply (6 in bank plus about 6 per round) covers all six players' needs for all five rounds if we don't waste it. I'm claiming 1.

Dev.say: Proposal: everyone claims only 1 token this round. The bank holds 6 plus a delivery of 4 to 8, so 6 claims of 1 fit in full, and everyone can pay their 1 token and survive. Over-claiming only hurts us all later, since the bank has to cover all five rounds.

Fay.say: Proposal for everyone: claim only 1 token per round. You need exactly 1 to survive each round, and if all six of us claim 1, everyone gets 1 and the bank keeps growing from deliveries. Greedy claims just push people out.

Ada.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. Six claims of 1 fit even in the smallest delivery, so everyone gets a token to spend and nobody is out. Greedy claims shrink the pool for everyone.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. The bank has 6 plus a delivery of 4 to 8, so the claims of 1 each are covered in full, and each of us can pay our end-of-round token. Greedy claims only cut the bank for everyone, including the greedy player's own survival chances over the five rounds.
